summary: Michelle Lindsay, 29, of Fort Collins caught and fully buried in an avalanche at 11,400 ft on the south side of Diamond Peak near Cameron Pass; her touring party dug her out but she was not breathing and was declared dead at the scene.
location: South side of Diamond Peak, near Cameron Pass
notes: Larimer County SO: 911 call ~2:45 PM Sunday; Larimer County SO deputies and Jackson County rescue resources responded. CAIC: 2-3 ft crown, ran ~425-500 vertical ft; first CO avalanche fatality of the 2019-20 season.
